# Order of the Ætherwright

> A practice for people who make things: eight glyphs name the domains of creative work, and the Codex records how each work was made.

## The doctrine

- Manifesto: https://aetherwright.com/doctrine/manifesto/
- The Glyphs: https://aetherwright.com/doctrine/glyphs/
- The Codex: https://aetherwright.com/doctrine/codex/
- The Sigil: https://aetherwright.com/doctrine/sigil/
- The Practice: https://aetherwright.com/doctrine/practice/
